title: Magical Buffs Anime's Trailer Unveils More Cast, LiSA's Opening Song, Early Netflix Streaming, January 4 TV Debut
content: Crunchyroll presented a new trailer and key visual for the television anime of Haka Tokura 's Magical Buffs: The Support Caster is Stronger Than He Realized! light novel serie at New York Comic Con on Thursday.
author: ANN

title: 'Ghost of Tsushima Kuroudo Kitan' Announces Additional Cast, Staff, 2028 Delay
content: The Crunchyroll showcase at New York Comic Con 2026 revealed additional cast and staff for the anime adaptation of Sucker Punch Productions' Ghost of Tsushima video game on Thursday. The anime has been delayed to 2028 from its originally planned 2027 premiere.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Teenage Mercenary' Reveals Main Staff, 2027 Debut
content: The Crunchyroll Showcase at New York Comic Con 2026 revealed the main staff, a teaser visual (pictured), and an announcement promo for the television anime adaptation of YC 's Teenage Mercenary webtoon on Thursday. The anime series will premiere in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Tickets Available for Godzilla Minus Zero in UK in November
content: Tickets are available for Godzilla Minus Zero , the new Godzilla film from Godzilla Minus One 's Takashi Yamazaki , at https://godzillafilm.co.uk/ . The film will open in IMAX cinemas on November 3, and in general cinemas on November 6. The London Film Festival describes the film as follows: "Japan, 1949.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll Manga Launches in India, Bangladesh, Bhutan, Nepal, Pakistan, Sri Lanka
content: The Crunchyroll Anime Future Forum announced on Thursday that the company is launching Crunchyroll Manga in India. The service will also launch in the United Kingdom, Ireland, Bangladesh, Bhutan, the Maldives, Nepal, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Australia, and New Zealand.
author: ANN

title: J.C. Staff Animates Teenage Mercenary Webtoon for 2027 Broadcast
content: Crunchyroll announced at New York Comic Con on Friday that J.C. Staff is animating the previously announced adaptation of YC and Rakyeon's original webtoon Teenage Mercenary (Nyūgaku Yōhei in Japanese) for broadcast next year.
author: ANN

title: The Remarried Empress Webtoon Gets TV Anime From TROYCA in 2027
content: Crunchyroll announced at New York Comic Con on Friday a television anime adaptation of HereLee and SUMPUL 's webtoon The Remarried Empress . (The webtoon is itself based on Alphatart 's original web novel.) TROYCA is animating the project for broadcast next year.
author: ANN

title: 'Kininatteru Hito ga Otoko ja Nakatta' Reveals Additional Cast, Staff, First Promo
content: The Crunchyroll Showcase at New York Comic-con 2026 revealed additional cast, staff, and a promotional video for the television anime adaptation of Sumiko Arai 's Kininatteru Hito ga Otoko ja Nakatta ( The Guy She Was Interested in Wasn't a Guy at All ) manga on Thursday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Webtoon 'The Boxer' Gets TV Anime
content: The Crunchyroll Showcase at New York Comic Con 2026 announced a television anime adaptation of Ji-Hoon Jeong 's The Boxer webtoon on Thursday, revealing the main cast, staff, and a special promotional trailer.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Webtoon 'The Remarried Empress' Gets TV Anime in 2027
content: The Crunchyroll Showcase at New York Comic-con 2026 announced a television anime adaptation of Alphatart and Sumpul 's The Remarried Princess webtoon on Thursday and revealed the main cast, staff, a fourth character visual (pictured), and special promotional video. The anime series will premiere in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList
